settings.card_description: We source premium-quality dry fruits from trusted growers in Afghanistan, Uzbekistan, and the surrounding regions. Our long-term relationships with local farmers ensure consistent quality, ethical practices, and competitive pricing.

Our high-end factories are equipped with advanced machinery including laser sorters, metal detectors, and automatic washing/drying lines. We guarantee food safety, consistent quality, and strict hygiene standards certified by ISO 22000, ISO 9001, HACCP, and HALAL.

We offer a variety of packaging solutions tailored to your market needs:
• Retail pouches (200g to 1000g) with or without zip locks
• Efficient documentation for smooth customs clearance
• Gift formats (one large master box containing smaller packs)

Whether you require bulk shipments for industrial use or consumer-ready retail packs, we provide complete flexibility.

We partner with reliable logistics providers to ensure safe and timely delivery worldwide. Our experienced team handles:
• Flexible Incoterms (EXW, FOB, CIF, etc.)
• Efficient documentation for smooth customs clearance
• Air, sea, and land transport options
We are committed to delivering your goods on schedule and in perfect condition.
